content.what_it_is: Variant of plot_bathy_stations.m for the FUNWAVE-TVD tide_frf_abc_data case that marks only a subset of gauge stations. Identical pipeline: reads station i,j indices from ../work/station.txt (L11-L13), binary dep.out [m n]=[660 800] reoriented by transpose+flipud+fliplr (L16-L22), background image frf_03.jpg (L26), coordinate registration x=[1:m]*1.+105, y=[n:-1:1]*1.0+220 (L29-L31), 6x8-inch jet figure (L33-L38), land NaN-ed via dep(dep<0)=NaN (L46), rotated image + pcolor(X,Y,-dep) (L48-L51). The difference: file_sta=[1 4 7 10 12 13] (L52) selects 6 stations; the loop maps each selection through k=14-file_sta(kk) (L55) into the station table and labels them sequentially G1..G6 via txt=['G' num2str(kk,'%.d')] (L57). Finishes with caxis [-10 5], reference line, axis [30 765 250 950], colorbar, labels (L61-L66) and prints plots_movies/depth_station_less.jpg/.eps (L69-L70).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
DimsX — cell holding fread dimensions [m n] (L9)
station — station index table from station.txt (L11)
dep — depth field, reoriented, land NaN-ed (L18-L22, L46)
x — x coordinates registered to image (L29)
y — y coordinates registered to image, reversed (L30)
file_sta — selected station numbers to display (L52)
k — mapped row index into station table (L55)

equations.ref: mapping selected station number to station-table row (reverse order)
sequential relabeling G1..G6 of the selected stations

io.name: bathymetry pcolor over image with 6 selected station markers

unresolved: The double relabeling — station-table row k=14-file_sta(kk) (L55) but display label G<kk> (L57) — means G1..G6 on this figure do not correspond to the G-numbers in the sibling plot_bathy_stations.m (which labels G<14-k>); the mapping between displayed labels and physical FRF gauges is not documented in the file.
Label position again uses the row-index offset Y(sta_j(k)-15,sta_i(k)) (L58), failing if sta_j(k)<=15.
Assumes exactly 13 stations in station.txt (the constant 14 at L55); not verifiable here.
Stale comments at L40-L45 ('make up breaker and foam', 'eta without breaker') are copied from the movie script and do not describe this code.
